en.t: Emperor Louis II of Italy and Empress Engelberga are captured by Prince Adelchis of Benevento
en.s: Louis II (825 – 12 August 875), sometimes called the Younger, was the king of Italy and emperor of the Carolingian Empire from 844, co-ruling with his father Lothair I until 855, after which he ruled alone. Louis's usual title was imperator augustus ("august emperor"), but he used imperator Romanorum ("emperor of the Romans") after his conquest of Bari in 871, which led to poor relations with the Eastern Roman Empire.

zh.t: 意大利皇帝路易二世与皇后恩格尔贝加被贝内文托亲王阿德尔基斯俘虏
zh.s: 路易二世（825年—875年8月12日），又称小路易，自844年起担任意大利国王和加洛林帝国皇帝；他与父亲洛泰尔一世共同执政至855年，之后独自统治。他惯用“尊贵的皇帝”头衔，但871年征服巴里后改用“罗马人的皇帝”，使他与东罗马帝国的关系恶化。

en.s: The Milanese War of Succession was a war of succession over the Duchy of Milan from the death of duke Filippo Maria Visconti on 13 August 1447 to the Treaty of Lodi on 9 April 1454.

zh.s: 米兰公国继承战争是围绕米兰公国继承权展开的战争，从公爵菲利波·玛丽亚·维斯孔蒂于1447年8月13日去世开始，至1454年4月9日《洛迪和约》签订结束。

en.s: The fall of Tenochtitlan, the capital of the Mexica, was an important event in the Spanish conquest of the Mexica. It occurred in 1521 following extensive negotiations between local factions and Spanish conquistador Hernán Cortés. He was aided by La Malinche, his interpreter and companion, and by thousands of indigenous allies, especially Tlaxcaltec warriors.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 墨西加人的首都特诺奇蒂特兰陷落，是西班牙征服墨西加人的重要事件，发生于1521年。此前，当地各派与西班牙征服者埃尔南·科尔特斯进行了广泛谈判。科尔特斯得到翻译兼伴侣马林切，以及数千名原住民盟友的协助，其中以特拉斯卡拉战士为主。

en.s: The Northern Seven Years' War (also known as the Nordic Seven Years' War, the First Northern War, the Seven Years' War of the North or the Seven Years War in Scandinavia) was fought between the Kingdom of Sweden and a coalition of Denmark–Norway, Lübeck, and Poland–Lithuania between 1563 and 1570.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 北方七年战争也称北欧七年战争、第一次北方战争、北方七年之战或斯堪的纳维亚七年战争，于1563年至1570年间在瑞典王国与丹麦—挪威、吕贝克及波兰—立陶宛组成的联盟之间进行。

en.s: The siege of Rheinberg 1586–1590, also known as the capture of Rheinberg of 1590, took place at the strategic Cologne enclave of Rheinberg (present-day North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany), one of the principal crossing-points over the Rhine on the stretch between the Electorate of Cologne and the Dutch border, between 13 August 1586 and 3 February 1590, during the Eighty Years' War, the Cologne War, and the Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604).

zh.s: 莱茵贝格围城战又称1590年攻占莱茵贝格，发生于1586年8月13日至1590年2月3日，地点是科隆选侯国的战略要地莱茵贝格（今德国北莱茵-威斯特法伦州）。莱茵贝格位于科隆选侯国与荷兰边境之间的莱茵河沿岸，是主要渡河点之一。这场围城战发生在八十年战争、科隆战争和英西战争（1585—1604年）期间。

en.s: The Treaty of Brömsebro (or the Peace of Brömsebro) was signed on 13 August 1645, and ended the Torstenson War, a local conflict that began in 1643 (and was part of the larger Thirty Years' War) between Sweden and Denmark–Norway. Negotiations for the treaty began in February the same year.

zh.s: 布勒姆瑟布鲁条约又称布勒姆瑟布鲁和约，于1645年8月13日签署，结束了托尔斯滕森战争。这场局部冲突始于1643年，交战双方为瑞典和丹麦—挪威，是三十年战争的一部分。条约谈判于同年2月开始。

en.t: Colonel George Monck of the English Army forms Monck's Regiment of Foot, which will later become the Coldstream Guards
en.s: The English Army was the army of the Kingdom of England from 1661 to 1707. It was raised by King Charles II after the Stuart Restoration of 1660 saw him ascend to the English throne, and consisted partly of personnel who were veterans of either the Royalist units Charles II maintained while exiled in France or the New Model Army.

zh.t: 英格兰陆军上校乔治·蒙克组建蒙克步兵团，后来该部队成为冷溪卫队
zh.s: 英格兰陆军是1661年至1707年间英格兰王国的军队。查理二世在1660年斯图亚特王朝复辟后登上英格兰王位，并组建了这支军队。军队成员部分来自查理二世流亡法国期间维持的保王派部队老兵，部分来自新模范军。

en.s: The Battle of Warrington Bridge was a skirmish fought on 13 August 1651 between the invading Royalist Scottish army of Charles II and Parliamentary forces under the command of Major-General John Lambert.

zh.s: 沃灵顿桥战役是1651年8月13日发生的一场小规模交战，交战双方为查理二世率领的入侵苏格兰保王党军队，以及约翰·兰伯特少将指挥的议会军。

en.s: The Battle of Buzhyn was a battle between Russo-Cossack army and army of Khmelintskiy's coalition fought on August 13, 1662, an parts of the Russo-Polish War (1654–1667) and the Ukrainian Ruin (1657–1687). The army of the Crimean Tatars and the Right-Bank Cossacks of Yurii Khmelnytsky forced to retreat tsarist troops and the Left-Bank Cossacks, stopping their advance into Right-Bank Ukraine.

zh.s: 布任战役于1662年8月13日爆发，交战双方是俄哥萨克联军与赫梅利尼茨基联盟军队。该战役属于俄波战争（1654—1667年）和乌克兰废墟时期（1657—1687年）的一部分。尤里·赫梅利尼茨基率领的克里米亚鞑靼军和右岸哥萨克迫使沙皇军队与左岸哥萨克撤退，阻止其推进至乌克兰右岸。

en.s: The First Battle of Novi Zrin (Hungarian: Zrínyiújvár) was fought on August 13, 1663, as part of the Austro-Turkish War (1663–1664), between the Kingdom of Hungary and the Kingdom of Croatia between troops commanded of Ban Miklós Zrínyi/Nikola Zrinski and the Ottoman army. The battle took place near Zrínyiújvár/Novi Zrin (Zrínyi/Zrinski's family's fortress) in present-day Croatia and resulted in Hungarian-Croatian victory.

zh.s: 第一次新齐林堡战役（匈牙利语：Zrínyiújvár）于1663年8月13日爆发，是奥土战争（1663—1664年）的一部分。交战双方为匈牙利王国和克罗地亚王国，对阵的将领是总督米克洛什·兹林伊／尼科拉·兹林斯基和奥斯曼军队。战斗发生在新齐林堡附近，该城堡是兹林伊／兹林斯基家族的堡垒，位于今克罗地亚境内。匈牙利—克罗地亚联军获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Blenheim (German: Zweite Schlacht bei Höchstädt; French: Bataille de Höchstädt; Dutch: Slag bij Blenheim) fought on 13 August [O.S. 2 August] 1704, was a major battle of the War of the Spanish Succession. The overwhelming Allied victory ensured the safety of Vienna from the Franco-Bavarian army, thus preventing the collapse of the reconstituted Grand Alliance.
en.n: War of the Spanish Succession: Battle of Blenheim: English and Imperial forces are victorious over French and Bavarian troops.

zh.s: 布伦海姆战役（德语：Zweite Schlacht bei Höchstädt；法语：Bataille de Höchstädt；荷兰语：Slag bij Blenheim）于1704年8月13日（旧历8月2日）爆发，是西班牙王位继承战争中的一场重要战役。盟军取得压倒性胜利，确保维也纳免受法巴联军威胁，从而避免重建后的“大同盟”瓦解。
zh.n: 西班牙王位继承战争：布伦海姆战役：英格兰和帝国军队战胜法国和巴伐利亚军队。

en.s: The western theatre of Dummer's War in the 1720s in northern New England was referred to as "Grey Lock's War". Grey Lock distinguished himself by conducting guerrilla raids into Vermont and western Massachusetts. He consistently eluded his pursuers, and acquired the name Wawanolet (also Wawanolewat, Wawanotewat), meaning "he who fools the others, or puts someone off the track." Grey Lock's War was not part of the conflicts between France and England.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: “灰锁战争”指1720年代杜默战争在新英格兰北部西部战区的冲突。灰锁以在佛蒙特州和马萨诸塞州西部发动游击袭击而闻名。他屡次躲过追捕，并获得了“瓦瓦诺莱特”（也作Wawanolewat、Wawanotewat）之名，意为“愚弄他人或让人迷失方向的人”。灰锁战争并非法国与英国之间冲突的一部分。

en.t: Johann Sebastian Bach leads the first performance of Nimm von uns, Herr, du treuer Gott, BWV 101, a chorale cantata on a famous tune
en.s: Johann Sebastian Bach composed the church cantata Nimm von uns, Herr, du treuer Gott (Take away from us, Lord, faithful God), BWV 101, in Leipzig for the tenth Sunday after Trinity and first performed it on 13 August 1724. It is based on the seven stanzas of the hymn of the same name by Martin Moller (1584), which is sung to the tune of "Vater unser im Himmelreich", Luther's metred paraphrase of the Lord's Prayer.

zh.t: 巴赫首次演奏宗教康塔塔BWV 101
zh.s: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫在莱比锡创作了宗教康塔塔《求主信实之神除去我们的重担》（Nimm von uns, Herr, du treuer Gott；BWV 101），并于1724年8月13日、三一节后第十个主日首次演出。作品以马丁·莫勒1584年创作的同名赞美诗七段歌词为基础，采用路德对《主祷文》的格律改写曲调《Vater unser im Himmelreich》。

en.s: The Raid on Matina or the Battle of Matina, was a small but significant military engagement that took place on 13 August 1747 between British Baymen and Miskito from Mosquitia and Spanish colonial forces over the Spanish fortification at Matina, in the Talamanca region. The engagement was part of a larger conflict which was known as the War of Jenkins' Ear.

zh.s: 马蒂纳袭击战又称马蒂纳战役，于1747年8月13日爆发，是一场规模较小但影响重大的军事冲突。战斗发生在塔拉曼卡地区的马蒂纳西班牙殖民地要塞附近，交战双方为来自莫斯基蒂亚的英国巴伊门人和米斯基托人，以及西班牙殖民军。这场冲突是詹金斯耳朵战争的一部分。

en.s: The siege of Havana was the capture of the Spanish-held city of Havana, Cuba in 1762 as part of the war between Britain and Spain which formed part of the larger Seven Years' War. After the Spanish abandoned their former policy of neutrality by signing the family compact with France, Britain declared war on Spain in January 1762.

zh.s: 哈瓦那围城战发生于1762年英西战争期间，是英军攻占西班牙控制的古巴哈瓦那之战。英西战争是七年战争的一部分。西班牙在与法国签订波旁家族协定、放弃此前的中立政策后，英国于1762年1月对西班牙宣战。

en.s: The Battle of the Flockey, fought on August 13, 1777, occurred in Fultonham near present-day Middleburgh in what is now Schoharie County (then Albany County), New York, and was a small part of the Saratoga campaign. It stemmed from a Tory uprising aiming to support British Lieutenant‑Colonel Barry St. Leger's northward advance.

zh.s: 弗洛基战役于1777年8月13日在富尔顿哈姆附近爆发，战场位于今纽约州米德尔堡附近、现今斯科哈里县（当时属奥尔巴尼县）。这是萨拉托加战役的一场小规模战斗，起因是托利派起义，意在支援英国中校巴里·圣莱杰向北推进。

en.s: The Penobscot Expedition was an unsuccessful expedition launched by the Massachusetts Provincial Congress during the American Revolutionary War. On June 17, 1779, 700 British Army troops under Brigadier-general Francis McLean landed on the coast of the District of Maine and established a series of fortifications around Fort George on the Majabigwaduce Peninsula in the upper Penobscot Bay with the goals of establishing a military presence on that part of the coast and establishing the colony of New Ireland.
en.n: American Revolutionary War: The Royal Navy defeats the Penobscot Expedition with the most significant loss of United States naval forces prior to the attack on Pearl Harbor.

zh.s: 佩诺布斯科特远征是美国独立战争期间马萨诸塞省议会发起的一次失败行动。1779年6月17日，弗朗西斯·麦克莱恩准将率领700名英军在缅因地区海岸登陆，并在佩诺布斯科特湾上游的马贾比加杜斯半岛乔治堡周围修建一系列防御工事，意在扩大英军在该海岸的军事存在，并建立新爱尔兰殖民地。
zh.n: 美国独立战争期间，英国皇家海军击败佩诺布斯科特远征军；在珍珠港遇袭之前，这是美国海军力量遭受的最重大损失。

en.s: The action of 13 August 1780 was a minor naval battle fought off the Old Head of Kinsale (County Cork, Ireland) in which the 64-gun French "private man of war" (privateer) Comte d'Artois fought two British Royal Navy ships, Bienfaisant and Charon, during the American Revolutionary War. After Royal Navy admiral George Rodney successfully brought relief to the defenders of Gibraltar, capturing a Spanish convoy off Cape Finisterre and eight days later winning the Battle of Cape St.

zh.s: 1780年8月13日海战是美国独立战争期间的一场小规模海战，发生在爱尔兰科克郡金塞尔旧角附近。64门炮的法国私掠船“阿图瓦伯爵”号与英国皇家海军的“仁慈”号和“查隆”号交战。皇家海军上将乔治·罗德尼成功为直布罗陀守军解围后，在菲尼斯特雷角附近俘获一支西班牙船队，并于八天后赢得圣……角海战。

en.t: King Louis XVI of France is formally arrested by the National Tribunal, and declared an enemy of the people
en.s: Louis XVI (Louis-Auguste; French: [lwi sɛːz]; 23 August 1754 – 21 January 1793) was the last king of France before the fall of the monarchy during the French Revolution. The son of Louis, Dauphin of France (son and heir apparent of King Louis XV), and Maria Josepha of Saxony, Louis became the new Dauphin when his father died in 1765. In 1770, he married Marie Antoinette.

zh.t: 法国国王路易十六被国家法庭正式逮捕，并被宣布为人民公敌
zh.s: 路易十六（路易·奥古斯特；法语：[lwi sɛːz]；1754年8月23日—1793年1月21日）是法国大革命推翻君主制之前的最后一位法国国王。他是法国王太子路易（路易十五之子和法定继承人）与萨克森的玛丽亚·约瑟法之子。1765年父亲去世后，路易成为新的王太子。1770年，他与玛丽·安托瓦内特结婚。

en.t: Battle of Sant Llorenç de la Muga
en.s: The Battle of Sant Llorenç de la Muga (in Catalan, in Spanish: San Lorenzo de la Muga) was fought on 13 August 1794 between an attacking Spanish–Portuguese army led by the Conde de la Unión and a French army commanded by Jacques François Dugommier. The local French defenders headed by Pierre Augereau and Dominique Pérignon repulsed the allies. The Spanish garrison of Fort de Bellegarde surrendered a month later.

zh.t: 圣洛伦索德拉穆加战役
zh.s: 圣洛伦索德拉穆加战役于1794年8月13日爆发，交战双方为德拉乌尼翁伯爵率领的西班牙—葡萄牙联军和雅克-弗朗索瓦·迪戈米耶指挥的法军。皮埃尔·奥热罗和多米尼克·佩里尼翁率领的当地法军守军击退了联军。一个月后，贝尔加德堡的西班牙守军投降。

en.s: The Battle of Mišar (Serbian: Бој на Мишару, romanized: Boj na Mišaru) was fought between Serbian revolutionaries and an Ottoman army, it took place from 13 to 15 August 1806 during the First Serbian Uprising. After repulsing an Ottoman force at Ivankovac, the year before, the Serbian insurgents under Karađorđe took strong position, entrenched in sconces on the field of Mišar Hill, near Šabac west of Belgrade.

zh.s: 米沙尔战役于1806年8月13日至15日爆发，是第一次塞尔维亚起义的一部分，交战双方为塞尔维亚革命者和奥斯曼军队。前一年在伊万科瓦茨击退奥斯曼军后，卡拉乔尔杰率领塞尔维亚起义军在贝尔格莱德以西、沙巴茨附近的米沙尔山战场上占据有利地势并修筑防御工事。

en.s: A naval engagement between USS Essex and HMS Alert took place on 13 August 1812, in which the light frigate, USS Essex, 32 (commanded by Capt. David Porter, USN) encountered and captured the British sloop Alert, 20 (Captain T.L.P. Laugharne). With "so trifling a skirmish" Porter later said, Alert became the first American capture of the war. The duel itself lasted a mere eight minutes, during which Essex fired only one broadside.

zh.s: 1812年8月13日，“埃塞克斯”号与“警戒”号交战。美国海军戴维·波特上校指挥的32炮轻型护卫舰“埃塞克斯”号，遭遇并俘获了英国海军T·L·P·劳恩船长指挥的20炮单桅纵帆船“警戒”号。波特后来称这只是“一场微不足道的小冲突”，“警戒”号因此成为美国在这场战争中俘获的第一艘英国舰船。交战只持续8分钟，“埃塞克斯”号仅发射了一次齐射。

en.s: The Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1814 (also known as the Convention of London; Dutch: Verdrag van Londen) was signed by the United Kingdom and the Netherlands in London on 13 August 1814. It was signed by Lord Castlereagh on behalf of the British government and Hendrik Fagel on behalf of the Dutch government. The treaty restored several of the Dutch colonies occupied by British forces during the Napoleonic Wars, although several others were permanently ceded to Britain. It also included Dutch acknowledgement of British opposition to the Atlantic slave trade and agreements to improve the Low Countries' defences.

zh.s: 1814年英荷条约又称《伦敦公约》（荷兰语：Verdrag van Londen），于1814年8月13日在伦敦由英国和荷兰签署。英国政府代表为卡斯尔雷子爵，荷兰政府代表为亨德里克·法赫尔。条约将拿破仑战争期间被英军占领的若干荷兰殖民地归还荷兰，但另有一些殖民地永久割让给英国。条约还包括荷兰承认英国反对大西洋奴隶贸易的立场，并同意改善低地国家的防务。

en.s: The Battle of Leuven or Battle of Boutersem was a battle of the Ten Days' Campaign during the Belgian Revolution. The battle took place on 12 August and officially ended on 13 August 1831. The Dutch army defeated the Belgian rebels, but were forced to withdraw in order to avoid war with France, as a large French army under Maréchal Gérard had crossed the border to support the Belgian rebels.

en.s: A referendum on dissolving the union with Sweden was held in Norway on 13 August 1905. Voters were asked whether they endorsed the Storting's declaration of 7 June that the personal union, in place since 1814, had ceased to exist. Dissolution was approved by 368,208 votes to 184, or 99.95% of valid votes, on a voter turnout of 85.4%, one of the most lopsided results in the history of national referendums. The vote was the first national referendum held in Norway, and the first in the Nordic countries.

en.s: A general election was held in the Northern Territory on Saturday 13 August 1977. Though the election was won by the incumbent Country Liberal Party (CLP), the party lost five of its seven executive members. Surprisingly, one of the casualties was Majority Leader Goff Letts—one of the few instances where a major-party leader at any level in Australia lost his own seat. The election also marked the emergence of the Australian Labor Party as a parliamentary force: Labor took six seats in the new assembly. The Progress Party contested the elections, winning 9.76% of the primary vote across the territory, but failed to secure any assembly seats.

en.s: The Selwyn by-election, a by-election in the New Zealand electorate of Selwyn - a predominantly rural district in the Canterbury Plains in New Zealand's South Island - took place on 13 August 1994. The previous sitting MP, Ruth Richardson, precipitated the poll by resigning from parliament. Richardson planned to retire from politics, having been removed as Minister of Finance the previous year. The by-election was significant, as National held on to the majority of the House of Representatives by only one seat (50 to 49).

en.s: The 2014 DFL-Supercup was the fifth edition of the German Super Cup under the name DFL-Supercup, an annual football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Bundesliga and DFB-Pokal competitions. It featured Bayern Munich, winners of the 2013–14 Bundesliga, and Borussia Dortmund, the runners-up of the 2013–14 Bundesliga who also reached the 2014 DFB-Pokal final. Dortmund were the reigning champions, having beaten Bayern 4–2 in 2013, although the season before, Bayern beat Dortmund 2–1. Both teams had won four previous installments (of seven attempts by Bayern and six by Dortmund), and thus the winners would set a new record. The match took place on 13 August 2014 at Signal Iduna Park in Dortmund.

en.s: Eduardo Henrique Accioly Campos (10 August 1965 – 13 August 2014) was a Brazilian congressman and governor. Born and raised in Recife, in the Northeast Brazil, he graduated in Economics from the Recife's Federal University of Pernambuco. Campos' maternal grandfather, the governor of the Brazilian state, Pernambuco, made him his Financial Secretary. Campos became a federal congressman in Brazil and got Pernambuco federal money for a shipyard, railways and an oil refinery.
